component.description: 16-bit, 4-quadrant multiplying, current-output digital-to-analog converter (MDAC). sub_type: multiplying. An R-2R ladder (three MSBs segmented) whose external reference VREF is a bipolar signal input the ladder multiplies by the code; the IOUT terminal sources a current into a virtual ground and REQUIRES an external I-to-V precision op-amp closed through the on-chip matched feedback resistor RFB to produce a voltage (VOUT = -VREF to +VREF, unity transimpedance gain). Three-wire SPI (CLK, SDI, CS). Grade C (DAC8811ICDGK): INL and DNL +/-1 LSB. Pinout (8-lead VSSOP, DGK): 1 CLK, 2 SDI, 3 RFB, 4 VREF, 5 IOUT, 6 GND, 7 VDD, 8 CS.

pinout.name: CLK
pinout.description: Clock input; positive-edge triggered, clocks data into the shift register.

pinout.name: SDI
pinout.description: Serial register input; data loads MSB first, extra leading bits ignored.

pinout.name: RFB
pinout.description: Internal matching feedback resistor; connect to the external I/V op-amp output.

pinout.name: VREF
pinout.description: DAC reference (signal) input; establishes full-scale. Constant input resistance versus code.

pinout.name: IOUT
pinout.description: DAC current output; connects to the inverting terminal of the external precision I/V op-amp.

pinout.name: VDD
pinout.description: Positive power supply, 2.7 V to 5.5 V.

pinout.name: CS
pinout.description: Chip-select, active low; transfers shift-register data to the DAC register on the rising edge.

notes: multiplying sub_type MDAC. VREF is a bipolar signal input (-15 V to 15 V) that the R-2R ladder multiplies by the code; IOUT is a current into a virtual ground and requires an external I-to-V op-amp closed through the on-chip matched RFB. This exercises the MDAC cluster: multiplying_bandwidth, reference_input_resistance, feedback_resistance (RFB), full_scale_output_current, code-dependent output_capacitance, glitch_impulse in Vs, and reference_feedthrough in dB.

Full-scale gain error is printed in mV (typ +/-1 mV, max +/-4 mV). The dac dictionary key gain_error permits only % and ppm (no V), so this figure is carried on full_scale_error, whose altUnits include V - the datasheet names the parameter 'Full-scale gain error', which full_scale_error captures natively without an assumed full-scale-voltage conversion.

INL and DNL are printed in LSB (+/-1 LSB, DAC8811C grade). Per the dac dictionary, LSB is not a legal unit; +/-1 LSB at 16-bit = 1/65536 = 15.3 ppm of full-scale, with the printed LSB figure preserved in conditionsVerbatim.
glitch_impulse and digital_feedthrough are printed as '2 nV/s' but are the volt-second glitch/feedthrough energy (2 nV-s = 2e-9 Vs), carried in the Vs unit per the dictionary.

reference_input_resistance (5 kohm +/-25%) is explicitly code-INDEPENDENT for this part (Feature Description, p11); reference_input_capacitance (5 pF) is therefore noted code-independent on the CODE axis. output_capacitance (50 pF) IS code-dependent (IOUT-terminal impedance changes versus code, p12).

feedback_resistance (RFB) is not tabulated as a standalone numeric; 5 kohm is inferred from the printed matched-ladder relationship (RFB ratio-matched to the 5 kohm R-2R ladder giving VOUT = -VREF to +VREF unity gain, p11), and is marked guarantee by_design.

serial_clock_frequency (fCLK 50 MHz) and esd_hbm (+/-4000 V) are represented as limits (max / absolute_max) rather than typical, matching the datasheet's maximum clock rate and ESD classification level.

Page numbers are the printed DAC8811 (SLAS411D) pages, confirmed against the fetched PDF (SHA-256 491af32e...): pinout p4, Abs Max / ESD / Recommended Operating / Thermal p5, Electrical Characteristics p6, Timing Requirements p7, Detailed Description / RFB / ladder p11-12.
